# Third-party MSX2 HUD font candidates

Fonts in this folder were downloaded only when the source provided a clear permissive font license suitable for commercial game use. Each family folder includes the original license text and local metadata.

## Import priority

1. `tiny5/Tiny5-Regular.ttf` - best compact first pass for MSX2 HUD text and numbers.
2. `silkscreen/Silkscreen-Regular.ttf` - good 5x8-ish retro UI candidate with strong readability.
3. `micro-5/Micro5-Regular.ttf` - useful for very small counters after legibility testing.
4. `press-start-2p/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf` - strong title/score style, but wide for dense HUDs.
5. `pixelify-sans/PixelifySans-wght.ttf` - modern readable pixel UI fallback for menus or longer labels.

## License note

All downloaded font families above are under SIL Open Font License 1.1. OFL allows commercial use, embedding, bundling, modification, and redistribution, but the font cannot be sold by itself and modified versions must continue under OFL. Reserved Font Names, when present, must not be used for modified versions.

## Excluded during research

Direct ZX Spectrum/Sinclair ROM font recreations were not imported unless the licensing was clearly commercial-safe. In particular, sources that mention Sinclair/Amstrad/Sky copyright or non-commercial permission are unsuitable for this folder.
